items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was someone else singing in on it named Robert… Rosario.

ctx.x: …you haven't mentioned him, did you know Bob Crowder?
No. I don't remember hearing Robert with the group. When I heard it I was already in New York, and they had already established themselves with putting paint on their faces and everything.
Well did you guys meet? Did you talk? Was it just always musical?
